spanish: Y harás dos anillos de oro, y los pondrás sobre dos extremos del joshen, sobre su labio que a lado del efod hacia adentro.

findings.issue: הַחֹשֶׁן is a common noun (H2833); joshen leaves that lemma untranslated.
בָּיְתָה is the noun house (H1004) plus directional he; hacia adentro drops house and resolves the direction as inward.

notes: Verbs, number, אתם, both על, and אשר אל־עבר stay inside the tokens.
